## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 22, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jade Eastwood_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "6/17/26 You can skip immediately for adds at first. Then it makes you wait thirty seconds. At first I was okay with it cuz it only gave me that after 10 or so chats, then it started coming after 5 or so. This is a greedy app that will try and make you buy their add free purchase. The add freeze doesn't even given you more memory, the memory sucks. 7/15/26 Update. The memory seems to have gotten worse. Especially the quality of how the AI talks, it makes more mistakes now. Ads come frequently."
            2. _Ohio resident with Internet_, Jul 26, 2026, 2/5: "experiencing issues lately... things aren't loading and responses get stuck mid sentence... worked fine until recently will change review if remedied good rp app, miles ahead of competitors like Chai, pollybuzz, ect"
            3. _Raquel Gil_, Jun 26, 2026, 2/5: "Great, they screwed up the app with the obligatory announcement and having to wait 30 seconds, I'm not saying it's bad but I can't chat well, it jumps every 7 MESSAGES, fix it. Besides, it's full of errors and glitches, when you spend a little time talking to the bot it says RANDOM words and the character barely speaks, a shame, I liked it better before, that's why the 2 stars. Besides, it is full of Bugs that take you out of the app and the language changes or does not understand you, it is very ugly 🙃"
